---

config:
    theme: 'base'
    themeVariables:
        primaryColor: '#1f2020'
        primaryTextColor: '#f0f0f0'
        background: '#333'
        primaryBorderColor: '#888888'
        lineColor: '#999'

---

stateDiagram

%% Initial state name as "." so that it fits in black circle shape.
%% See https://github.com/StateSmith/StateSmith/issues/404
state "." as ROOT.(InitialState)

OFF

OFF : OFF

OFF : enter / { set_power_relay(false); power = Power.OFF; }

OFF : TURN_OFF / { reply = Reply.OK; }

OFF : 1.( TURN_ON, START_BREW, ENTER_STEAM) [phase == Phase.FAULT] / { reply = Reply.FAULT; }

OFF : 2.( START_BREW, ENTER_STEAM) [phase != Phase.FAULT] / { reply = Reply.NOT_READY; }

OFF : FAULT_DETECTED / { phase = Phase.FAULT; }

OFF : FAULT_CLEARED / { phase = Phase.IDLE; }

state "ON" as ON {

        %% Initial state name as "." so that it fits in black circle shape.
        %% See https://github.com/StateSmith/StateSmith/issues/404
        state "." as (Ortho)(ON_REGION_1).(InitialState)

        STEAM_OFF

        STEAM_OFF : STEAM_OFF

        STEAM_OFF : 1. ENTER_STEAM [max_ms == 0] / { reply = Reply.INVALID; }

        STEAM_OFF : 2. ENTER_STEAM [max_ms != 0 && in_state(FAULT)] / { reply = Reply.FAULT; }

        state "STEAM_ON" as STEAM_ON {

                %% Initial state name as "." so that it fits in black circle shape.
                %% See https://github.com/StateSmith/StateSmith/issues/404
                state "." as STEAM_ON.(InitialState)

                STEAM_HEATING

                STEAM_HEATING : STEAM_HEATING

                STEAM_HEATING : enter / { steam_state = SteamState.HEATING; }

                STEAM_READY

                STEAM_READY : STEAM_READY

                STEAM_READY : enter / { steam_state = SteamState.READY; }

        }

        --

        %% Initial state name as "." so that it fits in black circle shape.
        %% See https://github.com/StateSmith/StateSmith/issues/404
        state "." as (Ortho)(ON_REGION_2).(InitialState)

        IDLE

        IDLE : IDLE

        IDLE : 1. START_BREW [max_ms == 0] / { reply = Reply.INVALID; }

        IDLE : 2. START_BREW [max_ms != 0 && power != Power.READY] / { reply = Reply.NOT_READY; }

        BREWING

        BREWING : BREWING

        BREWING : enter / { phase = Phase.BREWING; stop_reason = StopReason.NONE; set_pump(true); set_steam_heater(false); }

        BREWING : exit / { set_pump(false); set_steam_heater(in_state(STEAM_ON)); phase = Phase.IDLE; auto_off_from = now_ms; }

        BREWING : TURN_OFF / { reply = Reply.BUSY; }

        BREWING : START_BREW / { reply = Reply.BUSY; }

        FAULT

        FAULT : FAULT

        FAULT : enter / { phase = Phase.FAULT; }

        FAULT : (TURN_ON, START_BREW) / { reply = Reply.FAULT; }

        FAULT : FAULT_DETECTED / {  }

}

ROOT.(InitialState) --> OFF

OFF --> ON : 3. TURN_ON [phase != Phase.FAULT] / { reply = Reply.OK; }

OFF --> ON : MACHINE_POWER_SWITCH [phase != Phase.FAULT]

ON --> OFF : TURN_OFF / { reply = Reply.OK; }

ON --> OFF : 1. MACHINE_POWER_SWITCH [in_state(BREWING)] / { stop_reason = StopReason.MACHINE; }

ON --> OFF : 2. MACHINE_POWER_SWITCH

ON --> OFF : do [!in_state(BREWING) && elapsed(auto_off_from) #62;= auto_off_min * 60000]

(Ortho)(ON_REGION_1).(InitialState) --> STEAM_OFF

STEAM_OFF --> STEAM_ON : 3. ENTER_STEAM [max_ms != 0 && !in_state(FAULT)] / { reply = Reply.OK; steam_cmd_max_ms = max_ms; }

STEAM_OFF --> STEAM_ON : MACHINE_STEAM_BUTTON [!in_state(FAULT)] / { steam_cmd_max_ms = device_max_steam_ms; }

STEAM_ON --> STEAM_OFF : LEAVE_STEAM / { reply = Reply.OK; }

STEAM_ON --> STEAM_OFF : MACHINE_STEAM_BUTTON

STEAM_ON --> STEAM_OFF : FAULT_DETECTED

STEAM_ON --> STEAM_OFF : 1. do [elapsed(steam_cmd_at) #62;= steam_cmd_max_ms]

STEAM_ON --> STEAM_OFF : 2. do [after(device_max_steam_ms)]

STEAM_ON.(InitialState) --> STEAM_HEATING

STEAM_HEATING --> STEAM_READY : STEAM_TEMP_READY

STEAM_READY --> STEAM_HEATING : STEAM_TEMP_HEATING

(Ortho)(ON_REGION_2).(InitialState) --> IDLE

IDLE --> BREWING : 3. START_BREW [max_ms != 0 && power == Power.READY] / { reply = Reply.OK; start_source = StartSource.APP; brew_cmd_max_ms = max_ms; }

IDLE --> BREWING : MACHINE_BREW_SWITCH_ON / { start_source = StartSource.MACHINE; }

IDLE --> FAULT : FAULT_DETECTED

BREWING --> IDLE : 1. do [after(brew_cmd_max_ms) && (start_source == StartSource.APP)] / { stop_reason = StopReason.COMMAND_CAP; }

BREWING --> IDLE : 2. do [after(device_max_brew_ms)] / { stop_reason = StopReason.DEVICE_CAP; }

BREWING --> IDLE : 3. do [start_source == StartSource.APP && elapsed(last_write_at) #62;= heartbeat_timeout_ms] / { stop_reason = StopReason.HEARTBEAT; }

BREWING --> IDLE : STOP_BREW / { reply = Reply.OK; stop_reason = StopReason.APP; }

BREWING --> IDLE : MACHINE_BREW_SWITCH_OFF / { stop_reason = StopReason.MACHINE; }

BREWING --> IDLE : LINK_LOST [start_source == StartSource.APP] / { stop_reason = StopReason.LINK_LOST; }

BREWING --> FAULT : FAULT_DETECTED / { stop_reason = StopReason.FAULT; }

FAULT --> IDLE : FAULT_CLEARED / { phase = Phase.IDLE; }
